test_scenarios.name: single_event_round_trip
test_scenarios.description: Send one TraceEvent through bridge.emit() and verify both JSONL and Tracera receive it.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: JSONL file size grows by 1 line; TraceraAdapter.append_event called 1 time.

test_scenarios.name: include_kinds_filter
test_scenarios.description: Emit events of 3 kinds; verify only those in include_kinds are mirrored to Tracera.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: JSONL has 3 events; TraceraAdapter receives only kinds in include_kinds (1 of 3).

test_scenarios.name: tracera_unreachable_fails_soft
test_scenarios.description: Point bridge at unreachable host; verify JSONL receives the event and bridge.tracera_errors increments.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: JSONL has the event; bridge.tracera_errors == 1; no exception propagates.

test_scenarios.name: flush_batch_drains_buffer
test_scenarios.description: Use enqueue_event to fill the buffer; call flush; verify all events reach Tracera.
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: TraceraAdapter.append_event called N times (where N == buffer size); bridge buffer_size == 0 after flush.

test_scenarios.name: sample_rate_full
test_scenarios.description: sample_rate=1.0; all events should reach Tracera (no skipping).
test_scenarios.expected_outcome: TraceraAdapter.append_event called N times for N events.

test_scenarios.name: sample_rate_zero
test_scenarios.description: sample_rate=0.0; no events should reach Tracera (all skipped).

test_scenarios.name: cohort_on
test_scenarios.description: PHENO_ENV=staging with cohort policy 'on'; verify bridge.active_cohort() returns 'on'.

test_scenarios.name: error_rate_alert
test_scenarios.description: Bridge adapter that raises 10% of the time; verify alert_error_rate fires warn severity.

next_action: Set PHENO_ENV=staging on staging hosts; restart pheno-harness service; validate via tracera://history MCP resource.
